The Psalms pair it with other fearsome creatures — the deaf adder that stops its ear (Ps 58:4) and the lion and dragon that the faithful will tread upon (Ps 91:13). Isaiah's messianic vision pictures an infant playing safely over the cobra's hole (Isa 11:8), transforming the symbol of death into a sign of paradise restored."
